oral_examination.oral_examination: *38 Vertical low impaction, percussion (-), no abnormality in the buccal mucosa, nothing special. CBCT showed: there was no low-density image in the root tip.

source_handle: *38 Explain the condition, treatment plan, cost, prognosis, etc. to the patient, and the patient is informed and agrees to the treatment. Local iodophor disinfection, 2% lidocaine inferior alveolar nerve block anesthesia, separation of the gums after the anesthesia takes effect, extraction of loose teeth, routine scraping of the extraction socket, reduction of the extraction socket, and suturing to stop bleeding.
